input.label: SUPPORTED
input.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that Amazon's AWS segment operating income for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 exceeded $12 billion. 

Challenge H1 is REFUTED: Evidence E12 provides a clear breakdown showing AWS operating income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 was $17,773 million ($17.773 billion), not $11,434 million. The table structure shows columns for "Three Months Ended September 30, 2025 2026" where $11,434 represents Q3 2025 and $17,773 represents Q3 2026. This is further confirmed by E1 which shows the same figures in the same column structure.

Challenge H2 (restatements/adjustments) found NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE: The retrieved evidence discusses other income/expense items related to Anthropic investments but contains no information about restatements or adjustments to AWS operating income for Q3 2026.

Challenge H3 (segment methodology changes) found NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE: Evidence E18 describes the segment reporting methodology but provides no indication of any changes to the AWS segment definition or methodology that would affect the Q3 2026 figures.

The AWS segment operating income for Q3 2026 was $17,773 million ($17.773 billion), which clearly exceeds the $12 billion threshold stated in the claim. The verdict remains SUPPORTED with no changes from the initial assessment.
